actions.title: Get Linus ready for Pirates picture day

payload.notes: Clean full uniform and photo order form ready before the 5:00pm picture, with the game right after.
payload.why: Picture day runs straight into the game on Oct 5 and needs the uniform and order form in hand.

actions.title: Plan Linus's birthday — it lands on a Pirates game day

payload.notes: Linus turns a year older Oct 26 and the Pirates vs Knuckleheads game starts 6pm that evening — decide gift and whether to celebrate before the game or the weekend prior.
payload.why: His birthday collides with a game, so the plan and the gift want deciding early.

actions.title: Sort out Nutcracker rehearsal ride during Grandma and Grandaddy's

payload.notes: Tomorrow's rehearsal at 2pm falls in the middle of the 11:30am–8:30pm visit at Grandma and Grandaddy's — decide who drives and when you leave.
payload.why: The two overlap tomorrow and someone has to get to rehearsal.

actions.title: Close out the trip that started Sep 14

payload.notes: The trip has been open since Sep 14 with no end date — record the return or mark it finished.
payload.why: An open-ended trip is still marked under way five days on.

actions.title: Plan Adelaide's birthday — it falls during Jackson Brave Together

payload.notes: Adelaide's birthday is Oct 19, the same day Jackson Brave Together starts — sort out gift and celebration timing now.
payload.why: Her birthday collides with a multi-day commitment, so it needs planning ahead rather than on the day.

actions.title: Arrange school absence for Rose and Linus's dentist appointment

payload.notes: Appointment is 8:00–9:30am ET on Oct 12; notify the school about the late arrival.
payload.why: The appointment is during school hours, so the school needs notice beforehand.

actions.title: Chase the orders still stuck on "out for delivery"

payload.notes: Several Amazon orders have been showing out for delivery or shipped without ever being marked delivered — check tracking and file a missing-package claim on any that never arrived.
payload.why: A cluster of packages never moved past "out for delivery," which usually means something went missing.

actions.title: Check the four orders still sitting on "shipped"

payload.notes: Orders 724cd27b, 43c236ac, trackingupdate and "order from" are all still in transit with no delivery — pull up tracking and see which ones have stalled.
payload.why: Several shipments have been in transit with no movement and aren't covered by the out-for-delivery chase.

payload.notes: Seamus turns 1 on Nov 3 — decide on cake, gift and who to invite while there's still time to order anything.
payload.why: It's the one upcoming birthday with nothing planned yet.

payload.notes: Magnus's birthday is Oct 14 — order the gift with a week of shipping room.
payload.why: First of the run of October birthdays, and ordering early avoids a rush.

notes.status: what the person is doing or dealing with right now, in plain words, as an observer would put it: on jury duty, stranded waiting for a tow, travelling, sick; never a feeling, a quote or a wish
notes.age: the person's age in years, true at the observation's at; write birthday instead once the date is known
notes.school: where or how the person is schooled: "home schooled", or a school as {"ref": "org/..."}
notes.location: where the person is: a place body as {"ref": "place/..."} when the ship has one, else a short place name; null when they have left and the new place is unknown
notes.relationship: how they relate to the owner: wife, son, boss, neighbour
notes.income: a money fact about the person; kept from client keys by policy
notes.health: a medical fact about the person; kept from client keys by policy

notes.status: the state the thing is in right now: broken down, at the shop, shipped, delivered
notes.location: where the thing is: a place body as {"ref": ...} or a short place name; null when unknown

notes.next: the start of the nearest upcoming occurrence, ISO 8601 UTC
notes.schedule: when it recurs, in words: Tue/Thu 16:45, first Saturday of the month
notes.last: the start of the most recent occurrence, ISO 8601 UTC, with at set to that start

notes.status: open or closed, or cancelled; nothing else. Whether it is upcoming, under way or over is read off starts, ends, started and ended
notes.ends: when it is scheduled to end, ISO 8601 UTC; may be in the future
notes.ended: when it actually ended, ISO 8601 UTC, written once it has
notes.started: when it actually began, ISO 8601 UTC, written once it has
notes.starts: when it is scheduled to begin, ISO 8601 UTC; may be in the future
notes.participants: one observation per body involved, value {"ref": ...}

task.notes: optional: what to do, in a sentence

note.text: required: the note for the owner

home.service: required: a Home Assistant service, e.g. light.turn_on

message.to: required: the body id of the person, e.g. person/andrea
message.text: required: the message, short, in the owner's own voice
